motion.name: native-state
motion.purpose: Route and control feedback follows native motion and honors reduced motion.

narrative.overview: Crays uses the familiar physical objects exchanged during a night out to make venue entry, social contact, commerce, and access feel grounded. Dark wine surfaces support low-light use; paper artifacts carry explanations and credentials.
keyCharacteristics: Wine-black tonal surfaces with warm-white text
Paper and woven artifacts only when they communicate meaning
Large Swiss-style headlines and familiar native controls

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The primary gradient identifies the one committed action on a screen; secondary actions remain text or outlined controls.

dos: Do preserve the tactile night-out vocabulary while adapting controls to each platform.
Do use semantic color utilities and shared components.
donts: Don't use protocol jargon as primary product copy.
Don't request permissions before demonstrating their value.
